name: Calendar Scheduler
summary: Multi-timezone calendar scheduler for React with month, week, day and agenda views, availability windows and slot booking.
description: A scheduling calendar component built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS with month, week, day and agenda views. Admins set recurring weekly availability and slot durations of 15, 30 or 60 minutes; viewers see and book slots converted to their local timezone, with booked-slot tracking. Installs from a shadcn registry or by copying src/components/calendar; free for non-commercial use.
contains: month, week, day and agenda views
